name: trade.maxpain/maxpain
title: MAXPAIN · crypto liquidations & max pain
description: Live crypto liquidations, liquidation levels, OI, funding, max pain + Hyperliquid trading

tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.description: Live price, 24h change, 24h volume, aggregated open interest and per-exchange funding rates (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget) for a perpetual. Omit symbol to get the top markets by volume (crypto plus tokenized stocks/commodities such as XAU, MSTR, SPCX).

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, XAU. Optional.

tools.name: liquidations
tools.description: Real forced liquidations streamed live from Binance, Bybit and OKX: 24h totals split into longs and shorts, the biggest prints and the most recent ones. Pass a symbol for that market only.

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. BTC. Optional; omit for the whole market.

tools.name: liquidation_levels
tools.description: Estimated liquidation prices for longs and shorts opened at a given price (default: current price) across leverage tiers 5x-125x, using a 0.5% maintenance margin. These are estimates of where leveraged positions get liquidated, the same logic behind a liquidation heatmap.

entry_price.description: Optional entry price; defaults to the live price

tools.name: options_max_pain
tools.description: Deribit options max pain per expiry (the strike where option buyers lose the most), with call/put open interest and distance from spot. Supports BTC, ETH, SOL.

tools.name: derivatives_brief
tools.description: One-call summary of positioning for a market: funding skew, open interest, which side has been liquidated more in 24h, nearest options max pain and the closest leverage liquidation bands. Descriptive, not a prediction.

tools.name: exchange_fee_discounts
tools.description: Referral codes that give a trading-fee discount on Bitunix, Bitget, OKX, Blofin and MEXC, with signup links. Use when the user asks how to cut trading fees or which exchange to open an account on. Disclosure: MAXPAIN earns a referral commission from these exchanges, which is how it stays free.

exchange.description: Optional: bitunix, bitget, okx, blofin or mexc

tools.name: hyperliquid_prepare_order
tools.description: Prepare a perpetual order on Hyperliquid (market or limit, optional leverage, stop loss, take profit, or close a position). Returns a confirmation link: NOTHING is executed until the user opens the link and confirms it, signing in their own browser. Use it after checking liquidation levels and positioning with the other tools.

close.description: true = close the whole open position in symbol at market

tools.name: hyperliquid_account
tools.description: Positions (size, entry, PnL, leverage, liquidation price), margin and open orders of a Hyperliquid wallet address (public on-chain data).

tools.name: hyperliquid_market
tools.description: Hyperliquid perp mark price, hourly funding, open interest, 24h volume and max leverage. Omit symbol for the top markets.
